name: RPG Character
annotation: Read-only, celebratory character sheet reached from Me Main: the constellation radar is the singular focal hero (Life Power in the sun hub, one CIA read), the character card and domain skills stay quiet and source-labeled, and ranked magnitude / streak & rewards / mission history round out the record. Every metric is real, low-confidence, or honest-null — no fabricated stats, no shame language for low domains. Deeper cross-domain comparison is the only premium gate.
belowFold: Remaining DomainSkillCard entries continue the grid below the visible six, each honest-null "--" plus "log one entry to begin." until logged
GroupedBarChart continues past Fitness/Wellbeing to rank every active domain; unstarted domains ghost, never rendered as a failing bar
BadgeWall shows further recent unlocks beyond the KPIRow strip; rarity is communicated by icon shape and label, never color alone

Mission history ListRow items (recent completed missions, most-recent first) scroll below the "view all" header; empty state reads "Complete a goal to see your journey here. Start with one small mission."
Sheet (domain sub-stats): opens on a domain-card or radar-axis tap; shows the domain trend, a log-entry CTA, and its own ChipProvenance
CelebrationOverlay and the green arrival line render only on a live level-up event, never on cold load
trustControls: ChipProvenance "via RPG stats" on the Life Power sun-hub value; honest-null reads "Building your balance - add your first domain to get started." — never a fabricated aggregate
Level/XP low-confidence shows "estimated · low confidence" (muted) while a domain re-syncs; honest-null renders level 1 beginner with a ghosted XP track, never a guessed number
Domain stat score honest-null renders "--" plus "log one entry to begin." on tap; low-confidence shows a dashed bar while the source is partial
Streak/rewards honest-null: "No active streak - start a new one today."; low-confidence caches the last synced value with a sync label
Mission history honest-null: "Complete a goal to see your journey here. Start with one small mission."; low-confidence dims cached rows
OfflineBanner keeps cached stats visible with a staleness label; pull-to-refresh and dashboard links dim (Disabled) and no refresh haptic fires while offline
Radar has a list alternative ordered by domain score; level and XP always read as text, not just a progress fill; badge rarity never relies on color alone
Deeper cross-domain/user comparison beyond the screen's own Ranked chart is the only premium gate (PaywallLock blur + single orange CTA) — the character record itself is never paywalled

modules.build: iOS status bar: time left, signal/wifi/battery right, paper-100 icons on dark shell (#0A0A0F + top-center amber radial glow, 3-4% grain). Fixed 44px, no copy.

Transparent TopBar: back chevron, 44px target, left, returns to Me Main. Centered title "your *character*" — Newsreader Medium Italic on "character," the screen's one emphasis word. No trailing action.

GlassCard r28: circular Avatar (tap opens Profile Edit), name "Hamza," level badge "level 14," rank line "dedicated explorer," XP ProgressBar "2,450 / 5,809 XP to level 16" drawn as a continuous orange line. Low-confidence: "estimated · low confidence" muted; honest-null: level 1 beginner, ghosted track.

ConstellationRadar hero, glass-card, full 10-domain shape; sun hub reads "Life Power 487" with ChipProvenance "via RPG stats" (glow-you). One CIA line below, glow-cia: "Strongest in Fitness; Meditation has room to grow." Honest-null: "Building your balance - add your first domain to get started." Polygon draws sequentially; list alt ordered by score.

DOMAIN SKILLS overline. SolidCard grid, ChipDomainTag + DomainSkillCard each: "Fitness 74," "Wellbeing 62," "Career 55," "Nutrition 51," "Finance 48," "Learning --" (honest-null dash, tap opens Sheet: "log one entry to begin."). Low-confidence: dashed bar while source is partial.

RANKED overline. GroupedBarChart, SolidCard, magnitude bars: "Fitness" and "Wellbeing" rows visible, gauges fill on scroll. Unstarted domains ghost, never shown as failing. Deeper cross-domain comparison beyond own ranking sits behind PaywallLock, single orange CTA.

STREAK & REWARDS overline. KPIRow: "42 days · 2.5x XP · 2 freezes." BadgeWall row of recent unlocks beside it, rarity shown by icon/label not color. Honest-null: "No active streak - start a new one today." Low-confidence: cached values with sync label.

MISSION HISTORY overline with trailing "view all" ghost link (44px target) pushing Mission Journal. ListRow items scroll below (belowFold). Honest-null: "Complete a goal to see your journey here. Start with one small mission." HomeIndicator anchors screen base.

notes: Route strictly /life-world — no alternate vanity route (per Consent and Safety). Level-up: green arrival line + restrained CelebrationOverlay + brief haptic, never a reward storm; reduced motion collapses radar, gauges, bars, and celebration to instant end-state. Motivation-tier: Low shows character card + radar + top-3 domains + one history prompt; Medium is default (this composition); High expands the full domain grid, sub-stats, deltas, rewards metadata, and history. Cross-links preserved: avatar -> Profile Edit [50]; domain cards/radar axes -> sub-stats Sheet with "view dashboard"; long-press a radar spoke scrubs that domain; mission rows -> Mission Detail [14]; badges -> Celebration [42] or Achievements [71]; "view all" -> Mission Journal [73]. Error: failed sections show ErrorState, cached data kept where possible ("Couldn't refresh - pull again"). Loading: "Building your character - one moment." Fonts: Hanken Grotesk (UI) + Newsreader Medium Italic (emphasis word) stand in for Neue Montreal/Tiempos per session waiver W-FONT-01. No manipulative scarcity or shame language for low domain scores — unstarted domains ghost, never render red/failing.
